title: StegVerse Build Trajectory
purpose: Publish concise, evidence-backed weekly accomplishment reports without conflating implementation, validation, release or deployment, runtime proof, and governed activation.

publication_policy.sensitive_evidence_policy: Publish bounded receipts, digests, and safe evidence links only. Exclude credentials, personal data, private legal fields, and complete custody payloads.

evidence_stages.label: Release / deployment
evidence_stages.meaning: A version or surface was delivered.

reports.title: September 2–4, 2026
reports.summary: Initial evidence baseline; no earlier weekly report is used for comparison.

completed_outcomes.outcome: StegVerse-001 completed one authentic bounded-autonomy cycle.
completed_outcomes.proof: Current-iPhone execution G23 recorded SV001_BOUNDED_AUTONOMY_CYCLE_COMPLETED under a consumed TV/TVC lease, with same-execution reconstruction passing. Receipt digest: sha256:81a078eeeacffb8fc86d287d7aaa8a9904c6f53973471dad7f6d7c3fa6818a35.
completed_outcomes.boundary: This proves the bounded cycle, not complete activation.

completed_outcomes.outcome: StegClaw v1.0.0 was validated and released.
completed_outcomes.proof: Release ID 381434394 targets 6b89a4b…; exact-head self-test and artifact digest were recorded. Release awareness reached Site, Publisher, admissibility-wiki, and stegguardian-wiki.

completed_outcomes.outcome: StegVerse-002 released the frozen v0.3 T0 experiment snapshot.
completed_outcomes.proof: Ten repository releases were reconciled to pinned commits and classified as EXPERIMENT_SNAPSHOT_RELEASE.
completed_outcomes.boundary: This is an experiment snapshot—not a product release, principal execution, deployment, or activation.

completed_outcomes.outcome: The canonical shared resident-carrier source converged.
completed_outcomes.proof: StegVerse-001, StegVerse-002, and SV-011 share the HB32/HB-derived InTr/WorkerCoordinator substrate at source level. PR #975 merged as b1f2bb3… after the declared validation suites passed.
completed_outcomes.boundary: Source convergence and validation do not prove resident execution or activation.

completed_outcomes.proof: Capability and predicate resolution, mandatory preflight, truth reconciliation, continuous discovery, consumer propagation gates, and resident proof instrumentation are implemented.
completed_outcomes.boundary: Two authentic runtime predicates remain unobserved.

completed_outcomes.outcome: StegBusiness and StegBusiness-Ops gained material operational artifacts.
completed_outcomes.proof: Entity and lifecycle registries, business evidence controls, patent/IP boundaries, seven candidate-LLC packets, finance/contract/compliance controls, official-form gates, and a deterministic validator exist. Twenty-one entity-specific PDFs were generated and official source forms were hash-verified.
completed_outcomes.boundary: Repository binary import and private completion remain outstanding.

completed_outcomes.outcome: Entity Economy publication source was integrated in Site.
completed_outcomes.proof: The article, canonical nine-page PDF route, Papers index entry, and News Releases entry exist on main. A live iPhone observation proved Current News Releases ordering.
completed_outcomes.boundary: Fresh observation of the landing page, PDF opening, and featured Papers entry remains pending.
